headline: A preprint separates abstention and noise filtering as two functions of attention gates
summary: An arXiv v2 paper argues that softmax attention lacks two distinct functions: abstaining when no context item is useful and filtering interference within values it reads. The author specifies separate mechanisms and reports matched training comparisons from 10M to 350M parameters in which gating gains shift from mostly abstention at the smallest scale to filtering contributing about as much at the largest; the effects are largely additive. Interference-injection experiments and checks on pretrained models up to 20B are also reported. This is one author-team study; downstream capability gains, production impact and independent reproduction remain unestablished.
